text: Read the task objective and inspect the current room before choosing an action.
Use the exact object names shown by the environment when issuing commands.
Navigate through available doors to locate required objects rather than guessing remote object locations.
Inspect inventory to confirm that an object has been picked up before attempting to use it.
For a measurement task, locate the appropriate instrument and the target substance before measuring.
After an invalid action, inspect the returned observation and choose a supported command instead of repeating it.
When the task requests a target object, identify its relevant properties before focusing on it.
For a device task, inspect its connections and power source before attempting to activate it.
